redfin.remarks: Incredible Cash-Flowing 4-Plex with Value-Add Upside & 8 Parking Spaces ! Attention investors! Don’t miss this exceptional four-unit income-producing property situated on a spacious 7,432 sq. ft. lot in East Los Angeles (90063). The desirable unit mix includes one large 3-bedroom/2-bath unit, one 3-bedroom/1-bath unit, and two 2-bedroom/1-bath units. The property also offers a landlord-friendly expense structure. All four units are separately metered for gas and electricity, and tenants pay for gas, electricity, and trash. The landlord is primarily responsible for water. A major highlight is the large, gated parking area with 8 dedicated parking spaces, a significant advantage in this high-demand rental market. Located in a quiet and developing East Los Angeles neighborhood with convenient access to major freeways, shopping, dining, Citadel Outlets, and Downtown Los Angeles. An excellent opportunity for investors seeking a strong cash-flowing asset, future upside, or a potential 1031 exchange replacement property.
